riskProfile.note: Equity is the day-end wallet balance (rounded, day-level snapshot) and the loss is a ledger close event, not the risk taken at entry.

principles.stated: “출금해라”, and stop re-depositing after a loss
principles.measured: 79.6% of ledger realised profit withdrawn in 56 completed events; total deposits 14.49 BTC. Withdrawal motives and a no-redeposit rule are not established.

principles.stated: “보통 하루 정도 들고 있음” (holds about a day)
principles.measured: FIFO quantity-match median hold 13.2 h; this is not an exchange-reported position lifetime.

principles.stated: “승률에 더 신경 써라” (prefer hit rate over payoff ratio)
principles.measured: Positive ledger-entry share 66.99%, profit factor 1.70, payoff ratio 0.84; entry priorities cannot be inferred.

principles.stated: “시총이 큰 코인 위주로 매매” (trade the large caps)
principles.measured: XBTUSD + ETHUSD produced 80.2% of ledger profit; this is profit concentration, not evidence of a selection rule or its causal effect.

principles.stated: “자본의 최대 30% 이상을 잃지 않도록” (never risk more than ~30% of capital)
principles.measured: 97.5% of negative ledger entries were below 30% of the day-end book balance (20% threshold: 95.7%). This does not measure risk taken at entry.
The BitMEX ledger balance was 30–40% of published total-asset estimates at three dates. Other venues and the stated allocation cannot be verified here.

openDiscrepancy.what: Two 2019 posts state cumulative withdrawals roughly 43 BTC below the ledger. The two differences are similar, not identical.
openDiscrepancy.detail: 2019-05-06: stated 158 BTC, ledger 201.03800000 BTC, ledger-minus-stated 43.03800000 BTC. 2019-11-26: stated 298 BTC, ledger 341.12500000 BTC, ledger-minus-stated 43.12500000 BTC.
openDiscrepancy.reading: An internal transfer, a definition difference, or an error are possible explanations. These files do not establish which explanation is correct.
